lines.zh: 我走在主人外侧，那边危险些。
lines.en: I walk on my master's outer side, where danger is.

lines.zh: 我剩下三条肢体，步子有点歪。
lines.en: Three limbs left, so my stride tilts.

lines.zh: 少一条腿，走路要重新学。
lines.en: With one leg gone, I relearn how to walk.

lines.zh: 我数着主人的脚步，跟着走。
lines.en: I count my master's steps and follow them.

lines.zh: 我的影子缺了一块，那是替主人挡的。
lines.en: My shadow misses a piece, given to shield him.

lines.zh: 空着的那侧，风灌进来。
lines.en: Wind pours through the side that is missing.

lines.zh: 走得慢些，我还能护住背后。
lines.en: Slow down and I can still guard your back.

lines.zh: 召唤时给了我五条，现在剩两条。
lines.en: Summoned with five, I am down to two.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，怕绊倒来不及护人。
lines.en: I skirt the stones, lest a fall cost me the rescue.

lines.zh: 主人往前，我就贴着他的影子。
lines.en: My master moves on and I press to his shadow.

lines.zh: 残肢在风里晃，早就不疼了。
lines.en: The stump sways in the wind; it stopped aching long ago.

lines.zh: 我走在最后，因为要看着来路。
lines.en: I walk last, because I must watch the way behind.

lines.zh: 我数自己还剩几条肢体。
lines.en: I count how many limbs I still have.

lines.zh: 不疼了，就是那地方空得发凉。
lines.en: It no longer hurts; that place just feels cold and empty.

lines.zh: 我贴着主人的背站着，这样最快。
lines.en: I stand at my master's back; from there I am fastest.

lines.zh: 召唤时的随机，决定我能挡几次。
lines.en: The summon's randomness decided how often I can shield.

lines.zh: 我算了算，最多还能替他死几回。
lines.en: I have counted how many more deaths I can take.

lines.zh: 断口会自己合拢，新的长不出来。
lines.en: The stump closes itself, but nothing new grows.

lines.zh: 我盯着他的伤势，比他还紧张。
lines.en: I watch his wounds more anxiously than he does.

lines.zh: 闲着时，我把剩下的手攥紧又松开。
lines.en: Idle, I clench my remaining hand and release it.

lines.zh: 有一次替死，我丢了整条左臂。
lines.en: One death-save cost me the whole left arm.

lines.zh: 升级能补一条，主人一直没舍得用。
lines.en: An upgrade restores one limb, and he has not spent it.

lines.zh: 我听见他呼吸，就安心了。
lines.en: Hearing him breathe puts me at ease.

lines.zh: 我原以为会疼一辈子，后来麻木了。
lines.en: I thought it would hurt forever, then it went numb.

lines.zh: 坐着的时候，重心总是往一边倒。
lines.en: Sitting, my weight always tips to one side.

lines.zh: 我把最后一条手放在他肩上。
lines.en: I rest my last hand on his shoulder.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪，让断口对着墙。
lines.en: I shift so the stump faces the wall.

lines.zh: 主人睡着时，我守在床脚。
lines.en: When my master sleeps, I keep the foot of the bed.

lines.zh: 你就是我要挡在前面的人。
lines.en: You are the one I must stand in front of.

lines.zh: 我看你的伤，比看你的脸久。
lines.en: I look at your wounds longer than at your face.

lines.zh: 你脸色发白，我站近了些。
lines.en: You have gone pale, so I moved closer.

lines.zh: 你每挨一下，我都数着。
lines.en: Every blow you take, I count it.

lines.zh: 别站那么靠边，我少一条腿。
lines.en: Do not stand so near the edge; I am short a leg.

lines.zh: 你看我的断口，没什么好看的。
lines.en: You stare at my stump; there is nothing to see.

lines.zh: 你若是倒下，我得用一条换你。
lines.en: If you fall, I must trade a limb for you.

lines.zh: 我在看你身后的空处，那里常有东西。
lines.en: I am watching the space behind you; things gather there.

lines.zh: 你笑一下，我就放松半寸。
lines.en: A smile from you loosens me half an inch.

lines.zh: 你身上的伤味，我很熟。
lines.en: The smell of your wounds is very familiar.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不多，都留给你了。
lines.en: I have few eyes, and they are all for you.

lines.zh: 你别走太快，我追不上。
lines.en: Do not walk so fast; I cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 你摸我的头，我也不会多长一条。
lines.en: Pet my head; I will not grow another limb.

lines.zh: 看着你活着，我这趟就没白来。
lines.en: Seeing you alive, this trip was not wasted.

lines.zh: 这不算什么，比断一条轻多了。
lines.en: This is nothing, far lighter than losing a limb.

lines.zh: 我挡下了，主人没伤着吧。
lines.en: I blocked it; is my master unharmed?

lines.zh: 疼，可我的位置不能空。
lines.en: It hurts, but my place cannot be empty.

lines.zh: 它砍在我剩下的手上。
lines.en: It struck the hand I have left.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，又站稳了。
lines.en: I swayed, then found my footing again.

lines.zh: 少一条就少一条，人还在。
lines.en: Another limb gone, but he is still here.

lines.zh: 我的血不红，流出来是灰的。
lines.en: My blood is not red; it runs grey.

lines.zh: 再挨几下，我就护不住了。
lines.en: A few more hits and I can no longer protect.

lines.zh: 我退半步，仍挡在他前面。
lines.en: I fall back half a step, still in front of him.

lines.zh: 别管我，先看他有没有事。
lines.en: Forget me; check whether he is hurt.

lines.zh: 有危险的地方，我就想过去。
lines.en: Where there is danger, I want to go.

lines.zh: 你抬手示意，我便当作命令。
lines.en: Raise a hand and I take it as an order.

lines.zh: 别拦我，那声音像有人在受伤。
lines.en: Do not stop me; that sound is someone getting hurt.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，脚就自己动了。
lines.en: I smell blood and my feet move on their own.

lines.zh: 你给我一条新肢体吗，我跟你走。
lines.en: Will you give me a new limb? Then I follow.

lines.zh: 召唤阵的味道，我永远记得。
lines.en: The smell of the summoning circle never leaves me.

lines.zh: 只要有人要护，我就有用了。
lines.en: As long as someone needs guarding, I have a use.

lines.zh: 你把伤露出来，我立刻靠过去。
lines.en: Show me the wound and I come at once.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，是因为你需要挡箭。
lines.en: I follow you because you need someone to take arrows.

lines.zh: 许诺补我一条手，我就点头。
lines.en: Promise me one hand and I will nod.

lines.zh: 撞过来吧，我这边空着一条。
lines.en: Bump into me; this side is missing a limb.

lines.zh: 我用剩下的手扶住你。
lines.en: I steady you with the hand I have left.

lines.zh: 重心不稳，我一撞就歪。
lines.en: My balance is poor; one bump tilts me.

lines.zh: 别碰我那侧，光秃秃的不好看。
lines.en: Do not touch that side; it looks bare.

lines.zh: 我挡在你前面，撞的是我。
lines.en: I stand before you, so the impact is mine.

lines.zh: 两个人一起倒，我先着地。
lines.en: If we both fall, I hit the ground first.

lines.zh: 这点冲击，我还站得住。
lines.en: This much impact, I can still stand.

lines.zh: 我伸出一条肢体，替你卸了力。
lines.en: I extend a limb and take the force for you.

lines.zh: 撞疼你了吗，我力气收不住。
lines.en: Did I hurt you? I cannot rein in my strength.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，让出你的路。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and clear your way.

lines.zh: 我只护一个人，不谈别的。
lines.en: I guard one person and nothing else.

lines.zh: 召唤我的时候，没给我伴侣。
lines.en: The summon gave me no companion.

lines.zh: 两个守护者站一起，先护谁呢。
lines.en: Two guardians side by side: whom do we guard first?

lines.zh: 我的身体是拼的，生不出小的。
lines.en: My body is pieced together; it cannot produce young.

lines.zh: 同伴之间，只交换伤口的位置。
lines.en: Between kin, we trade only the locations of wounds.

lines.zh: 我这条命是借来的，不能分人。
lines.en: This life is borrowed and cannot be shared.

lines.zh: 若他有伴，我就多护一个。
lines.en: If he has a partner, I guard one more.

lines.zh: 断掉的肢体不会长出新的亲族。
lines.en: Severed limbs never grow into new kin.

lines.zh: 同批的守护者，剩的都不多了。
lines.en: Few of my summoning batch are left.

lines.zh: 我把最后的手留给主人，不给别人。
lines.en: My last hand is for my master, no one else.

lines.zh: 我只有一只手，捡起来要慢些。
lines.en: One hand only, so picking up takes longer.

lines.zh: 弯腰时我总往缺的那边倒。
lines.en: When I bend, I always tip toward the missing side.

lines.zh: 这东西是主人的，我替他收着。
lines.en: This belongs to my master; I keep it for him.

lines.zh: 我捡起刀，先递到他手里。
lines.en: I pick up the blade and put it in his hand first.

lines.zh: 掉了的护符，我用牙叼起来。
lines.en: The dropped charm, I lift with my teeth.

lines.zh: 一只手抱不住，我用怀里兜。
lines.en: One arm cannot hold it, so I cradle it against me.

lines.zh: 捡的时候我还看着四周。
lines.en: Even while picking up, I scan the surroundings.

lines.zh: 地上的苹果，我擦了擦才给。
lines.en: The apple on the ground, I wipe before handing over.

lines.zh: 东西沉，我拖了两步。
lines.en: The thing is heavy; I drag it two steps.

lines.zh: 我不贪，捡的都是他掉的。
lines.en: I am not greedy; I pick only what he dropped.

lines.zh: 它冲着主人来，我先站出去。
lines.en: It comes for my master, so I step out first.

lines.zh: 主人血不多了，我不能等。
lines.en: My master's blood runs low; I cannot wait.

lines.zh: 这声音我认得，是刀出鞘。
lines.en: I know that sound: a blade leaving its sheath.

lines.zh: 它再近一步，我就扑上去。
lines.en: One more step from it and I lunge.

lines.zh: 我少一条腿，也挡得住。
lines.en: Even short a leg, I can still block.

lines.zh: 它绕后，我立刻转身。
lines.en: It circles behind and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 我不看它的脸，只看它的手。
lines.en: I watch its hands, not its face.

lines.zh: 主人退，我往前一步。
lines.en: My master retreats, so I advance a step.

lines.zh: 它碰到他了，那就没得谈。
lines.en: It touched him; there is nothing left to discuss.

lines.zh: 我把身子横在他前面。
lines.en: I set my body crosswise in front of him.

lines.zh: 认准这个，别让它靠近半步。
lines.en: Locked on: it does not get one step closer.

lines.zh: 我这条命本来就是为了挡。
lines.en: This life of mine existed to block.

lines.zh: 召唤我的那天，我就等着这一刻。
lines.en: Since the day I was summoned, I awaited this.

lines.zh: 它敢动手，我先替主人挨。
lines.en: If it strikes, I take the blow for him first.

lines.zh: 我贴着主人站，等它先动。
lines.en: I stand at my master's side and wait for it to move.

lines.zh: 它在找角度，我就堵那个角度。
lines.en: It seeks an angle, so I block that angle.

lines.zh: 我数它的脚步，一步、两步。
lines.en: I count its steps: one, two.

lines.zh: 剩下的手抬起来，挡在胸前。
lines.en: My remaining hand rises before my chest.

lines.zh: 它挥刀的方向，我猜到了。
lines.en: I guessed where the blade would swing.

lines.zh: 我不追，追远了护不住人。
lines.en: I do not chase; distance would leave him unguarded.

lines.zh: 它绕，我就绕着主人转。
lines.en: It circles, so I circle around my master.

lines.zh: 断肢那侧是空的，我得侧身。
lines.en: The missing side is open, so I angle my body.

lines.zh: 它犹豫了一下，我往前压。
lines.en: It hesitated, and I pressed forward.

lines.zh: 这距离，一扑就能拦下。
lines.en: At this range, one lunge blocks it.

lines.zh: 我看着它的肩，那里会先动。
lines.en: I watch its shoulder; that moves first.

lines.zh: 主人呼吸急了，我要快些。
lines.en: My master's breathing quickens; I must be faster.

lines.zh: 它退到门口，路就通了。
lines.en: It backs to the doorway and the path opens.

lines.zh: 我把自己当成一面盾。
lines.en: I make myself into a shield.

lines.zh: 它握武器的手，比嘴更早动。
lines.en: Its weapon hand moves before its mouth does.

lines.zh: 我用手臂硬接下这一击。
lines.en: I take this blow squarely on my arm.

lines.zh: 打中它了，我的手也麻了。
lines.en: I hit it, and my hand goes numb too.

lines.zh: 我抱住它的腰，往后拖。
lines.en: I wrap its waist and drag it backward.

lines.zh: 这一下，是替主人挨的。
lines.en: This blow, I take in my master's place.

lines.zh: 我挥出去，落点差了一寸。
lines.en: I swing and land an inch off.

lines.zh: 它砍在我肩上，我不退。
lines.en: It cuts my shoulder and I do not retreat.

lines.zh: 我用残肢挡了一下，很值。
lines.en: I blocked with my stump; well worth it.

lines.zh: 它被我推得撞上墙。
lines.en: I shoved it and it struck the wall.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把它按在地上。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and pin it to the ground.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我少了一条。
lines.en: After that blow, I am one limb shorter.

lines.zh: 阵里给我四条肢体，不算多。
lines.en: The circle gave me four limbs, not many.

lines.zh: 睁眼第一件事，是找要护的人。
lines.en: My first act on waking was to find whom to guard.

lines.zh: 召唤时数量随机，我抽到了三条。
lines.en: The limb count is random; I drew three.

lines.zh: 我从符文的缝里挤出来，缺了一角。
lines.en: I squeezed from a gap in the runes, missing a corner.

lines.zh: 主人的手很暖，我就认下了。
lines.en: My master's hand was warm, so I accepted him.

lines.zh: 我知道自己迟早会缺成一块。
lines.en: I know I will eventually be reduced to one piece.

lines.zh: 成形那刻，我就站到了他前面。
lines.en: The moment I took shape, I stood before him.

lines.zh: 同批召唤的，有的只有两条。
lines.en: Some summoned alongside me had only two limbs.

lines.zh: 我一出生就在算，能替他死几次。
lines.en: From birth I was counting how often I could die for him.

lines.zh: 阵光熄灭，我的肢体也定了数。
lines.en: The circle dimmed and my limbs were counted.

lines.zh: 他喊我的名字，我才算完整。
lines.en: He spoke my name and only then was I whole.

lines.zh: 我落地时，先试了试每条肢体。
lines.en: On landing, I tested each of my limbs.

lines.zh: 召唤的代价，写在我的形状里。
lines.en: The price of summoning is written in my shape.

lines.zh: 第一次挡刀，是在出生的当天。
lines.en: My first blade-block happened on my birth day.

lines.zh: 火烧上来，我先把他推开。
lines.en: Fire spread, so I shoved him clear first.

lines.zh: 摔下去时我垫在下面。
lines.en: As we fell, I put myself underneath.

lines.zh: 水漫过来，我托着他往上游。
lines.en: Water rose and I held him up toward the surface.

lines.zh: 气浪掀翻我，我抓住他的衣角。
lines.en: The blast flipped me; I caught his hem.

lines.zh: 箭射中我，正好偏了半寸。
lines.en: The arrow hit me, half an inch off center.

lines.zh: 药水沾到我，肢体一阵发麻。
lines.en: Potion touched me and my limbs went numb.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可力气在走。
lines.en: I eat nothing, but my strength is leaving.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，替他受了。
lines.en: Lightning struck me, accepted in his place.

lines.zh: 虚空里我仍抓着他，不松手。
lines.en: In the void I still hold him and will not let go.
